mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates and reduces forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market recovery that reduces recession risk and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month and UNRATE>6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 400000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates supply chain contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls and RSAFS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.
